stem: The policy objectives of Reaganomics were based on the theory that —

options.label: A
options.text: borrowing from foreign countries would help cover the costs of domestic programs

options.label: B
options.text: significant increases in government spending would help reduce unemployment

options.label: C
options.text: broad tax cuts and financial deregulation would promote economic expansion

options.label: D
options.text: reducing trade barriers would result in a budget surplus

visual_elements: 53 The policy objectives of Reaganomics were based on the theory that —
A borrowing from foreign countries would help cover the costs of domestic programs
B significant increases in government spending would help reduce unemployment
C broad tax cuts and financial deregulation would promote economic expansion
D reducing trade barriers would result in a budget surplus
